offering_description.value: iHeartMedia produces and distributes radio shows, podcasts and streaming audio for listeners. It sells advertising and sponsorships to brands and agencies across its broadcast stations, digital platforms and live events. It also syndicates programming and provides advertising representation and software to broadcasters and audio publishers.

primary_products.value: radio and podcast programming; broadcast automation and scheduling software; digital audio advertising and measurement software

primary_services.value: radio broadcasting and audio streaming; advertising and sponsorship sales; program syndication; live event production; media sales representation

customer_segment.value: B2B: Local and national advertisers, media agencies, broadcasters and digital audio publishers; B2C: Radio and podcast listeners, streaming subscribers and live event attendees

end_markets.value: advertising and marketing; radio and digital audio entertainment; live music and events; broadcast and audio publishing technology

revenue_model.value: advertising: Broadcast, streaming and podcast ad placements and live event sponsorships; subscription: Paid streaming plans with on-demand music and playback features; commissions or management fees: Advertising sales representation for third-party radio and television stations; licensing or royalties: Syndicated programming and broadcast software for media operators; service fees: Ad delivery, audience measurement and monetization tools for audio publishers; other: Tickets to live music events
revenue_model.category: advertising; subscription; commissions or management fees; licensing or royalties; service fees; other

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Operates licensed radio stations that carry programming to listeners and sell airtime to advertisers; software / platform: Delivers owned and third-party audio to listeners and provides advertising and broadcast software to publishers; service provider: Produces programs and events for listeners and sells advertising for broadcasters; distributor: Syndicates programming to affiliated radio stations and distributes podcasts to third-party listening platforms
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; software / platform; service provider; distributor

geography_served.value: global: Broadcasting and live events primarily in the United States, with audio technology and podcast distribution internationally

specialization.value: related lines: Broadcast radio, streaming audio, podcasts, live events, media sales representation and audio technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Local and national sales teams serving advertisers, agencies and sponsors; other: Company-operated terrestrial radio stations; online: Company websites and apps, plus self-service advertising tools; partners / resellers: Affiliated radio stations, third-party podcast apps and connected-device platforms
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; other; online; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FCC licensing and ownership rules for U.S. radio stations, plus music licensing requirements for broadcast and streaming
